**Grade **: First Class Honours
Winner of the British Society for Immunology Graduate of the year award.
Recipient of the summer studentship from the Genetics Society (2017).
A Levels: Biology, Chemistry, Maths

Designed and implemented the end-to-end bioinformatic analysis for high-throughput single cell mosaic drug screening, deploying hyperscale cloud infrastructure to run alignment and quality-control pipelines for ~3 million cells. Designed and implemented scalable analysis tools (bixverse, contributor) for cell demultiplexing, sensitivity profiling of cell lines, transcriptomic stratification and multi-omic biomarker identification.

Drove biomarker discovery in glioblastoma by conducting WGS analysis on 80 primary tumour-derived cell lines, delivering comprehensive genetic characterisation (SNVs, SVs, CNVs). Integrated genomic profiles with CRISPRi screen data using advanced statistical models to uncover novel genetic dependencies and biomarker-target pairs.

Built a target prioritisation framework that integrated high-throughput CRISPRi phenotypic screen data with public evidence from OpenTargets, enabling systematic ranking of candidate targets to feed the discovery pipeline.

Co-developed an agentic hypothesis-generation platform that integrates CoSyne's internal omics data with public evidence from OpenTargets, ChEMBL, DepMap and ClinicalTrials.gov. Exposed to Claude as a set of MCP tools, agents plan and execute their own multi-step queries across both, chaining rare-variant genetic evidence to CRISPR dependencies and drug tractability to propose and rank novel target hypotheses for experimental follow-up.

Owned ingestion into the company DuckLake lakehouse, curating 70+ schema-validated tables that unify internal RNA-seq, WGS, methylation, CRISPR and drug-response data with public resources including OpenTargets, DepMap NextGen 3D screens, CCLE/PRISM and Orphanet, creating a single queryable evidence base for target identification.

Executed single-cell CNV (sc-CNV)
calling on proprietary perturb scRNA-seq data, identifying sub-clonal populations and
contributing to the target identification platform.

Internal R&D: Responsible for developing an internal container system using Docker and ECR. Author and Lead developer on several internal R and Python packages with responsibilities for maintenance. Established best practices for code development and review. Designed the templating system for all internal projects & packages using cruft.

Led analysis of large-scale genomic datasets to support biomarker discovery and target identification, translating complex results into clear, decision-ready outputs for cross-functional teams. Culminated in the successful partnership with a publicly traded biotech.

Co-Developed and maintained internal & open source R and Python packages. For statistical modelling, data processing and visualisation. Bixverse, is a Rust based R package enabling the analysis of 3 million single cells on a standard laptop. Cosyne-cnvutils is a python package used for the analysis of genomics data.
Developed internal container system using Docker and ECR, to enable reproducible research. This system used CI/CD to build images robustly and securely.

Recognised as a named
contributor in version 3.4.1 of the NF-core Sarek pipeline. Optimised the running of the pipeline, achieving a 50% cost reduction
and 30% decrease in computational time per sample.

Co-developed an internal MCP server exposing CoSyne's omics lakehouse and public biomedical APIs to LLM agents. Authored the DuckLake SQL catalog and query layer: a curated, allowlisted table catalog encoding row grain, join keys and data caveats, with server-side SELECT-only validation and row caps forming the safety boundary for model-generated SQL. Connected to Claude, enabling agents to reason across internal and public data and generate testable hypotheses.

Led ingestion for the company DuckLake lakehouse, a Postgres catalog over Parquet on S3 queried with DuckDB, landing 70+ schema-validated tables spanning internal RNA-seq, WGS, methylation, CRISPR and dose-response data alongside OpenTargets, DepMap, CCLE/PRISM and Orphanet. Built a polars and pandera validation layer enforcing a declared schema on every write, shipped via Docker/ECR images and GitLab and GitHub CI.
Built an internal Shiny app giving colleagues a point-and-click interface to query all of CoSyne's internal data, so scientists without programming experience can interrogate the data directly.

Directed projects focusing on high-dimensional
omics data types (WES, WGS, scRNA-seq, proteomics), delivering comprehensive analyses and
reports for clients.

Developed in-depth knowledge of statistical
methodologies, mastering model selection and fitting techniques, including SVM, elastic net,
random forest, and linear/logistic regression, while accounting for covariates.

Actively contributed to internal
R&D by developing and maintaining specialised R packages, enhancing the team's analytical
capabilities.

Led client calls, effectively communicating
complex analytical results, ensuring clarity and client understanding.

Developed novel bioinformatics pipelines for Epigenome/Genome wide association studies, mQTL
analysis and quality control of Illumina EPIC array data.

Took the lead on a project performing EWAS and GWAS analysis in ADHD patients. This involved
fitting linear and logistic regression models while accounting for covariates.

Was selected for a secondment to New York to work at the
Mount Sinai medical school as a visiting bioinformatician (cancelled due to COVID-19).
Developed novel bioinformatics pipelines for processing genomics data.
Gained an understanding of regression analysis, how to account for covariates, feature selection and optimal model fitting.
